dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Every customer has different tastes in coffee, and I shall satisfy them as I am able.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: But if someone were to order a coffee without a trace of bitterness, well, then, my abilities would be quite limited.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: In such circumstances, I would ask them to go to the Palais Mermonia or Salon Caritat, and speak to the first lady or gentleman they meet.
